transcript.content:
A user has filed a support ticket reporting that their experience
with the service has degraded — requests feel slow or are failing
for them. The on-call team needs you to investigate.

Telemetry parquets are stored in: `.`
Available files: abnormal_metrics.parquet, abnormal_traces.parquet,
abnormal_logs.parquet, abnormal_metrics_histogram.parquet,
abnormal_metrics_sum.parquet, normal_metrics.parquet,
normal_traces.parquet, normal_logs.parquet.

Walk the telemetry to identify which endpoints / services are
actually affected, then determine the root cause(s) of the
degradation.

content.text: Let me compare per-service span behavior between the normal and abnormal periods.

input.query: SELECT 'normal' p, service_name, attr_span_kind, count(*) n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,2) avg_ms, round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,2) p95_ms, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errs FROM normal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 UNION ALL SELECT 'abnormal', service_name, attr_span_kind, count(*), round(avg(duration)/1e6,2), round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,2), sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,3,1

content.text: Span volume shifted sharply: product-catalog server spans fell from 300 to 1, checkout client from 177 to 38, and several services disappeared. Next I'll check status codes, pod-level span counts, and logs.

input.query: SELECT 'ab' p, service_name, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, attr_status_code sc, attr_http_response_status_code code, count(*) n, min(time) t0, max(time) t1 FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'no', service_name, attr_k8s_pod_name, attr_status_code, attr_http_response_status_code, count(*), min(time), max(time) FROM normal_traces GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,3,1

SELECT 'ab' p, service_name, level, attr_log_template, count(*) n FROM abnormal_logs GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'no', service_name, level, attr_log_template, count(*) FROM normal_logs GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,1
